content:
h07.

**Request URL:** `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar` — registered in `RegisterRoutes` at `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124` (group prefix `/file` at :122; confirmed by the test request `/file/users/avatar-owner/avatar`, `server/router/fileserver/fileserver_test.go:527`).

**Hops:**

1. `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168 (echo handler; the serving handler)
2. `Profile.AllowAnonymous` — internal/profile/profile.go:46 (gate: on a private instance anonymous viewers are rejected)
3. `FileServerService.getCurrentUser` — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:708 → `Authenticator.AuthenticateToUser` — server/auth/authenticator.go:190 (only on the private-instance path)
4. `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715 (builds `store.FindUser{Username: &identifier}`)
5. `Store.GetUser` — store/user.go:148 (checks `userCache` only when finding by ID; a username lookup falls through)
6. `Store.ListUsers` — store/user.go:136 (delegates to `s.driver`, then repopulates `userCache` via `userCacheKey`, store/user.go:88)
7. `Driver.ListUsers` (interface) — store/driver.go:47
8. `DB.ListUsers` (dialect impl) — store/db/sqlite/user.go:88, store/db/postgres/user.go, store/db/mysql/user.go — `SELECT ... avatar_url ... FROM user` (sqlite/user.go:159, :164)
9. `user` table, column `avatar_url TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''` — store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:20 (introduced store/migration/sqlite/0.11/00__user_avatar.sql:4)

**Then back out:** the image bytes are not a separate blob store — `user.AvatarURL` is a base64 **data URI** decoded in-process by `FileServerService.parseDataURI` (server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737), validated against `avatarAllowedTypes` (fileserver.go:75, :201), then written with `setSecurityHeaders` + cache headers and `c.Blob` (fileserver.go:205–209).

Two notes on the boundary:
- Authorization is asymmetric with attachments — avatars have no per-user permission check (no `checkAttachmentPermission` equivalent); once anonymous access is allowed by `AllowAnonymous`, any user's avatar is public by username.
- The same stored value also travels the gRPC/Connect path as `User.avatar_url` via `convertUserFromStore` (server/router/api/v1/user_service_converters.go:25), which is what the frontend `UserAvatar` component consumes (web/src/components/UserAvatar.tsx:8) — so the browser may render the avatar without hitting the file server at all.
